title_en: Analysing societal challenges using Geographical Information Systems
abstract_en: Online introduction to Geographical Information Systems for collecting, managing, analysing and visualising spatial data about societal challenges, by Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam.
description_en: The course introduces GIS concepts and applications and applies them to societal questions such as poverty, health and inequality in cities. It is open to third-year Bachelor and Master students of Aurora universities.
prerequisites_en: No formal prerequisites. An affinity for computers and bespoke applications and an interest in maps are strongly recommended.

title_en: Information Systems in E-Business and Online Commerce
abstract_en: Online course of Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam on the digital technologies that let online businesses operate and reach their customers.
description_en: Students translate business needs into technological solutions, assess digital innovations critically and work in teams on practical assignments whose findings they present.
learning_outcomes_en: Translate business needs into technological solutions; assess digital innovations critically; collaborate and present in teams.
